 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Extend the single-pixel diagonal trail from the terminal end of the shape.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    # Find the trail color (the color occurring many times) and continue its diagonal.
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts)
    color=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    trail=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if grid[r][c]==color]
    # Extend diagonal from last point, away from the dense seed/object.
    # Identify direction from trail points' displacement.
    dr=dc=0
    if len(trail)>=2:
        dr=1 if trail[-1][0]>trail[0][0] else -1
        dc=1 if trail[-1][1]>trail[0][1] else -1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if dr and dc:
        r,c=trail[-1]
        for _ in range(4):
            r+=dr;c+=dc
            if 0<=r<len(out) and 0<=c<len(out[0]): out[r][c]=color
    return out
"

    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    colors=set(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg)
    for col in colors:
        pts={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==col}
        # Diagonal two-or-more-pixel streaks determine a ray direction.
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
            line=[p for p in pts if (p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc) in pts]
            if not line: continue
            starts=[p for p in line if (p[0]-dr,p[1]-dc) not in pts]
            for r,c in starts:
                while (r-dr,c-dc) in pts: r-=dr;c-=dc
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
                    out[r][c]=col
                    r+=dr;c+=dc
    return out
"
